project.title: Lowe Martin DevOps

role_overview.summary: Lowe Martin Group is an Ottawa-based commercial printing and marketing services company serving both private sector clients and Government of Canada departments. Christian served as DevOps practitioner across two simultaneous workstreams, driving the transformation of the software development organization from an unstructured delivery model to an Agile and Scrum-based team while concurrently migrating the organization's on-premises mixed email environment — spanning Microsoft Exchange 2010 and Lotus Domino 9 — to Office 365. Both workstreams were executed over the same six-month engagement period.

challenge.summary: The client was performing extensive internal change, which required the re-organization of the Software Development team from an unstructured and chaotic team into a fluid Agile and Scrum based team.

solution.summary: Delivered comprehensive cloud and infrastructure solutions across:
deliverables: Office 365 Migration from Exchange & Domino Environments

outcomes: ✅ Delivered Office 365 Migration from Exchange & Domino Environments engagement
